text: Modernisation release ahead CRAN submission. DESCRIPTION updated use Authors@R, explicit Imports (doSNOW, foreach, gamm4, mgcv, MuMIn, nnet, parallel, stats, utils), added package repository URL. Removed unused R.rsp vignette builder declaration; package ship vignettes (see companion repository https://github.com/beckyfisher/FSSgam worked examples). Added runnable @examples exported functions. Added data-raw/, build_package_FFSgam.R, CLAUDE.md .Rbuildignore. Renamed core implementations generate_model_set() fit_model_set(). generate.model.set() fit.model.set() remain exported now deprecated wrappers (see R/deprecated.R) warn via .Deprecated() forward new names; full.subsets.gam() calls new names internally emit deprecation warnings. Replaced require()/bare calls throughout R/ explicit package::function() calls, class(x) == "y" checks inherits(x, "y"). Note: smooth-term constructors (s(), te(), t2()) kept unqualified inside model formulas, mgcv resolves literal symbol name formula parsing rather normal function dispatch – mgcv::s(...) inside formula work. Bug fix: full.subsets.gam()’s deprecated size argument (superseded max.predictors) -op – warned correctly never actually fed value max.predictors. Calling full.subsets.gam(size = n) now actually constrains model set n predictors, documented. Bug fix: full.subsets.gam()’s used.data predictor.correlations output fields always NULL (field-name mismatch referenced model.set$use.dat/$cor.matrix, don’t exist – actual fields $used.data/$predictor.correlations). now populated documented.
